block_boundary.rule: >1.1 → JPEG confirmed. DO NOT override with PSNR.

unique_G.rule: <200 → compression EXISTS. But JPEG may not be the cause — test JPEG2000 if PSNR fails.

hybrid_dt.rule: Hybrid mode: glass_detected→depth=4, else→depth=3. Best of both worlds.

dt_depth4_blur_first.rule: Trust when PSNR confirms blur→noise order. Use peeled_noise_check.py §B features.

dt_depth4_noise_first.rule: When noise→blur confirmed, mark noise type UNCERTAIN. Classification impossible.

reflection_triggers.condition: extreme_pct>50% AND noise_prior sigma<5 → likely JPEG/blur artifact, not real impulse
reflection_triggers.action: Ignore §B IMPULSE diagnosis. Trust noise_prior type. Test gaussian_RGB and noise_prior type only.
reflection_triggers.note: Known FP: JPEG/blur residuals inflate extreme_pct to 50%+ even without impulse noise.

agent_instructions.reason: sigma=3.8 ≥ 2 → PSNR不可靠, 必须用信号验证
agent_instructions.verdict_allowed: UNCERTAIN or POOR only (sigma>2 → NO LIKELY/GOOD)

candidates.note: PSNR不可用于噪声验证 — 使用信号验证

execution_order: 1. 按顺序测试每个候选: apply_multi.py → verify_signals.py
MATCH   → 保存, 进入下一步
PARTIAL → 【severity 扫描 ±1】: 同类型, sev±1 各测1次 → 选最佳
WEAK    → 【severity 扫描 ±2】: 同类型, sev±2 各测1次 → 若改善→保留; 否则换子类型
MISMATCH→ 【severity 扫描 ±2】: 先扫 severity, 仍无改善→换子类型 (≤2种替代)
3. 🔴 severity 扫描是强制步骤, 不可跳过。禁止在 WEAK 时直接换类型而不扫 severity。
4. 每类退化最多: 1个主候选 + 4个severity扫描 + 2个替代类型 = 7次测试
5. 所有步骤完成 → 合并 pipeline → 最终 verify_signals.py 确认
6. 保存 predicted_params.json (verdict 遵守允许值)

severity_scan_rules.when: verify_signals 输出 PARTIAL / WEAK / MISMATCH
severity_scan_rules.how: 保持函数名不变, severity 从 est-2 扫到 est+2 (限制 1-5 范围内)
severity_scan_rules.stop: 任一 severity 达到 MATCH → 立即停止扫描
severity_scan_rules.fallback: 全部 severity 未达 MATCH → 选 score 最高的, 然后尝试换子类型

forbidden: ❌ sigma>2 时使用 compare_degradation.py PSNR 判断候选好坏
❌ sigma>2 时设置 verdict=LIKELY 或 GOOD
❌ 跳过 verify_signals.py 直接用 PSNR 排名
❌ WEAK/MISMATCH 时跳过 severity 扫描直接换类型
❌ 测试超过 2 个 alternatives 不终止

cross_pair_consistency.noise: noise_prior sigma 3.83/0.74/1.48/0.74/0.37 for one identical pipeline -> sigma estimator is measuring gamma 8-bit contouring, not additive noise; smooth-region local_std of targets is BELOW the no-noise gamma simulation at every intensity -> NO noise
